description: Master networking fundamentals and step into a Security Operations Center role.

phases.title: Phase 1: Networking Foundations (Weeks 1–4)
items: IP Addressing & Subnetting — Professor Messer (free videos)
DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS — Understand how they work together
Build 1 project: Home lab with 2 VMs talking to each other

phases.title: Phase 2: Security Fundamentals (Weeks 5–8)
items: Firewalls, IDS/IPS basics — TryHackMe: Network Security
Wireshark — Capture and analyze your own traffic
SIEM Basics — Splunk Free or ELK Stack (pick one)
Build 1 project: Simulate a small network attack, then detect it

phases.title: Phase 3: SOC Analyst Skills (Weeks 9–12)
items: Log Analysis — Understand Windows Event Logs & Syslog
MITRE ATT&CK Framework — Learn the top 10 techniques
Incident Response Basics — TryHackMe: SOC Level 1 path
Apply for entry-level SOC / NOC roles — build a detection portfolio
